mapper.select: SELECT id, health_center_id, code, name, description, default_capacity, active FROM service_types WHERE active = true ORDER BY id
SELECT id, health_center_id, code, name, description, default_capacity, active FROM service_types ORDER BY active DESC, id
SELECT id, health_center_id, code, name, description, default_capacity, active FROM service_types WHERE id = #{serviceTypeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_types ( health_center_id, code, name, description, default_capacity, active, created_at ) VALUES ( #{healthCenterId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{defaultCapacity}, true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE service_types SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, default_capacity = #{defaultCapacity}, active = #{active}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{serviceTypeId}
UPDATE service_types SET active = false, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{serviceTypeId} AND active = true
UPDATE service_types SET active = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{serviceTypeId} AND active = false
mapper.select: SELECT id, health_center_id, email, name, phone, role, active FROM members WHERE role = 'STAFF' AND active = true ORDER BY id
SELECT id, health_center_id, email, name, phone, role, active FROM members WHERE id = #{staffId} AND role = 'STAFF'
SELECT id, health_center_id, email, name, phone, role, active FROM members WHERE email = #{email} AND role = 'STAFF'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members ( health_center_id, email, password, name, phone, role, active, created_at ) VALUES ( #{healthCenterId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, 'STAFF', true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, active = #{active}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{staffId} AND role = 'STAFF'
UPDATE members SET active = false, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{staffId} AND role = 'STAFF' AND active = true
mapper.select: SELECT sw.id AS window_id, sw.health_center_id, sw.window_number, sw.name AS window_name, sw.status, sw.active AS window_active, sw.staff_id, staff.name AS staff_name, st.id AS service_type_id, st.code AS service_type_code, st.name AS service_type_name, st.description AS service_type_description, st.default_capacity, st.active AS service_type_active FROM service_windows sw LEFT JOIN members staff ON staff.id = sw.staff_id LEFT JOIN service_window_service_types swst ON swst.service_window_id = sw.id AND swst.active = true LEFT JOIN service_types st ON st.id = swst.service_type_id AND st.active = true WHERE sw.active = true ORDER BY sw.window_number, st.id

SELECT sw.id AS window_id, sw.health_center_id, sw.window_number, sw.name AS window_name, sw.status, sw.active AS window_active, sw.staff_id, staff.name AS staff_name, st.id AS service_type_id, st.code AS service_type_code, st.name AS service_type_name, st.description AS service_type_description, st.default_capacity, st.active AS service_type_active FROM service_windows sw LEFT JOIN members staff ON staff.id = sw.staff_id LEFT JOIN service_window_service_types swst ON swst.service_window_id = sw.id AND swst.active = true LEFT JOIN service_types st ON st.id = swst.service_type_id AND st.active = true WHERE sw.id = #{serviceWindowId} ORDER BY sw.window_number, st.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_windows ( health_center_id, window_number, name, status, active, staff_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{healthCenterId}, #{windowNumber}, #{name}, #{status}, #{active}, #{staffId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE service_windows SET window_number = #{windowNumber}, name = #{name}, status = #{status}, active = #{active}, staff_id = #{staffId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{serviceWindowId}
UPDATE service_windows SET active = false, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{serviceWindowId} AND active = true
UPDATE service_window_service_types SET active = false, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE service_window_id = #{serviceWindowId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_window_service_types ( service_window_id, service_type_id, active, created_at ) VALUES ( #{serviceWindowId}, #{serviceTypeId}, true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (service_window_id, service_type_id) DO UPDATE SET active = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
